The function that handles the SignIn RPC on the backend is `APIV1Service.SignIn` located in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`.

This method is defined at line 51 and handles both password-based authentication and SSO (OAuth2) authentication. It validates credentials, checks permissions, and returns an access token and user information on successful authentication.

The method is called by the Connect service handler in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, which wraps it for the Connect protocol, but the core implementation is in the APIV1Service.
